5000:
**Ταβειθά** (Rec. Ταβιθά), ἡ (Aram. טַבְיְתָא or טְבִיתָא), 
**Tabitha**: [[44-acts.9.36|Act.9:36, 40]] (cf. Δορκάς).
(AS)
5001:
**τάγμα**, -τος, τό
(τάσσω), [in LXX chiefly for דֶּגֶל, also for חַי, רַגְלִי ;] 
**that which has been arranged or placed in order**; esp. as military term, **a company, troop, division, rank**: metaphorically, [[46-1-corinthians.15.23|1Co.15:23]] (see _ICC_, in l).
(AS)
5003:
**ταλαιπωρέω**, -ῶ
(ταλαίπωρος), [in LXX Chiefly for שָׁדַד pu. ;] 
1. **to do hard labour, suffer hardship or distress**: [[59-james.4.9|Jas.4:9.]] 
2. In cl. occasionally trans., to weary, distress (so [[19-psalms.17.9|Psa.17:9]], [[23-isaiah.33.1|Isa.33:1]]).
(AS)
5004:
**ταλαιπωρία**, -ας, ἡ
(ταλαίπωρος) [in LXX chiefly for שֹׁד ;] 
1. hard work (Hippocr.). 
2. **hardship, suffering, distress**: [[45-romans.3.16|Rom.3:16]] (LXX) pl., [[59-james.5.1|Jas.5:1]] (see B1., § 32, 6; WM, 220; Swete, _Mk._, 153). 
(Hdt., Thuc., al.; and cf. MM, xxiv.)
(AS)
5005:
**ταλαίωρος**, -ον 
[in LXX: [[19-psalms.137.8|Psa.137:8]] (שָׁדַד), [[23-isaiah.33.1|Isa.33:1]] (ποιεῖν τ., שָׁדַד), Tob.13:10, Wis.3:11, al. ;] 
**distressed, miserable, wretched**: [[45-romans.7.24|Rom.7:24]], [[66-revelation.3.17|Rev.3:17]].
(AS)
5007:
**τάλαντομ**, -ον, τ 
[in LXX for כִּכָּר ;] 
1. a balance (Hom.). 
2. **that which is weighed, a talent**; 
(a) **a talent in weight **(in Horn. always of gold); 
(b) **a sum of money, whether gold or silver, equivalent to a talent in weight **(see _DB_, iii, 418 ff.): [[40-matthew.18.24|Mat.18:24 25:15]] ff.
(AS)
5008:
**ταλειθά** (Rec. ταλιθά), (Aram. טְלִיתָא, see Dalman, _Gr._, 150), 
talitha, i.e. maiden: [[41-mark.5.41|Mrk.5:41.]]
(AS)
5009:
**ταμεῖον**
(late syncopated form of cl. ταμιεῖον; see M, _Pr._, 44 f.; Bl., § 6, 5; Thackeray, _Gr._, 63 ff.; Deiss., BS, 182 f.), -ον, τό, [in LXX chiefly for חֶדֶר ;] 
1. a treasury (Thuc., al). 
2. a store-chamber (Arist., Xen.; [[05-deuteronomy.28.8|Deu.28:8]]): [[42-luke.12.24|Luk.12:24]]. 
3. an inner chamber (Xen., Hell., v, 4, 5 [[23-isaiah.26.20|Isa.26:20]], al.): [[40-matthew.6.6|Mat.6:6 24:26]], [[42-luke.12.3|Luk.12:3]].
(AS)
5010:
**τάξις**, -εως, ἡ
(τάσσω), [in LXX: [[18-job.38.12|Job.38:12]] (מָקוֹם), [[19-psalms.110.4|Psa.110:4]] (דִּבְרָה), 2Ma.9:18, al. ;] 
1. an arranging, hence, in military sense, disposition of an army, battle array (Thuc., al.). 
2. **arrangement, order **(Plat., al): [[42-luke.1.8|Luk.1:8.]] 
3. **due order**: [[51-colossians.2.5|Col.2:5]] (_ICC_, in l); κατὰ τάξιν, [[46-1-corinthians.14.40|1Co.14:40.]] 
4. **office, order **(for exx., see MM, xxiv): [[58-hebrews.5.6|Heb.5:6]] (LXX), [[58-hebrews.5.6|Heb.5:6 6:20 7:11, 17]]" (LXX) .
(AS)
5011:
**ταπεινός**, -ή, -όν 
[in LXX for שָׁפָל, עָנִי, etc. ;] 
**low-lying**; metaphorically, 
(a) **lowly, of low degree, brought low**: [[59-james.1.9|Jas.1:9]], [[47-2-corinthians.7.6|2Co.7:6]] (cf. Sir.25:23); οἱ τ., opposite to δυνάσται, [[42-luke.1.52|Luk.1:52;]] τ. ταπεινοῖς (neut., R, txt.; masc., R, mg.; see _ICC_, in l), [[45-romans.12.16|Rom.12:16;]] 
(b) lowly in spirit, humble, in cl. usually in a slighting sense (see Tr., _Syn._, § xlii; but see also Abbott, _Essays_, 81), in NT in an honourable sense: [[47-2-corinthians.10.1|2Co.10:1;]] before τ. καρδίᾳ, [[40-matthew.11.29|Mat.11:29]] (cf. [[19-psalms.34.19|Psa.34:19]]); opposite to ὑπερήφανος, [[59-james.4.6|Jas.4:6]], [[60-1-peter.5.5|1Pe.5:5]]" (LXX) .
(AS)
5012:
**ταπεινοφροσύνη**, -ης, ἡ
(ταπεινόφρων) 
**lowliness of mind, humility**: [[44-acts.20.19|Act.20:19]], [[49-ephesians.4.2|Eph.4:2]], [[50-philippians.2.3|Php.2:3]], [[51-colossians.3.12|Col.3:12]], [[60-1-peter.5.5|1Pe.5:5]]; of a false humility, [[51-colossians.2.18|Col.2:18, 23]] (rare outside of NT, but found in bad sense in FlJ, BJ, iv, 9, 2; also in Epictet., see Tr., _Syn._, § xlii).
(AS)
5013:
**ταπεινόω**, -ῶ
(ταπεινός), [in LXX chiefly for עָנָה, also for שָׁפֵל, כָּנַע, etc. ;] 
**to make low**: ὄρος (βουνόν), [[42-luke.3.5|Luk.3:5]] (LXX). Metaphorical, **to humble, abase**: [[40-matthew.18.4|Mat.18:4 23:12]], [[42-luke.14.11|Luk.14:11 18:14]], [[47-2-corinthians.11.7|2Co.11:7 12:21]], [[50-philippians.2.8|Php.2:8]]; pass., [[40-matthew.23.12|Mat.23:12]], [[42-luke.14.11|Luk.14:11 18:14]], [[50-philippians.4.12|Php.4:12]]; id. with mid. sense, [[59-james.4.10|Jas.4:10]], [[60-1-peter.5.6|1Pe.5:6]].
(AS)
5014:
**ταπείνωσις**, -εως, ἡ
(ταπεινόω), [in LXX chiefly for עֳנִי ;] 
**abasement, humiliation, low estate**: [[42-luke.1.48|Luk.1:48]], [[44-acts.8.33|Act.8:33]]" (LXX), [[50-philippians.3.21|Php.3:21]], [[59-james.1.10|Jas.1:10]] (Plat., Arist., and later writers).
(AS)
5015:
**ταράσσω **
[in LXX for בָּהַל, רָגַז, etc., forty-six words in all ;] 
**to disturb, trouble, stir up**: primarily in physical sense (Hom., Eur.): τ. ὕδωρ, [[43-john.1.5|Jhn.1:5]] [4], [[43-john.1.7|Jhn.1:7.]] Metaphorical, of the mind (Æsch., Plat., al.), **to trouble, disquiet, perplex**: [[44-acts.15.24|Act.15:24]], [[48-galatians.1.7|Gal.1:7 5:10]]; ἑαυτόν (troubled himself; Westc., in l), [[43-john.11.33|Jhn.11:33;]] of a crowd, to stir up, [[44-acts.17.8|Act.17:8, 13]]; pass., [[40-matthew.2.3|Mat.2:3 14:26]], [[41-mark.6.50|Mrk.6:50]], [[42-luke.1.12|Luk.1:12 24:38]], [[43-john.12.27|Jhn.12:27]] ([[19-psalms.6.4|Psa.6:4]]) [[19-psalms.14.1|Psa.14:1]], 7, [[60-1-peter.3.14|1Pe.3:14]]" (LXX) ; τ. πνεύματι, [[43-john.13.21|Jhn.13:21]] (cf. δια-, ἐκ-ταράσσω) 
(AS)
5017:
**τάραχος**, -ου, ὁ
(ταράσσω), [in LXX for מְהוּמָה, etc. ;] 
**later form of ταραχή **(Xen., al.; see Thackeray, _Gr._, 159): [[44-acts.12.18|Act.12:18 19:23]]. 
(AS)
5020:
**ταρταρόω**, -ῶ
(Τάρταρος, a Greek name for the underworld, esp. the abode of the damned), 
**to cast into hell**: [[61-2-peter.2.4|2Pe.2:4]] (see Mayor, in l).
(AS)
5021:
**τάσσω **
[in LXX chiefly for שׂוּם, also for צָוָה pi., נָתַן, etc. ;] 
**primarily, in military sense, then generally, to draw up in order, arrange in place, assign, appoint, order**: with dative (accusative) and inf. (Bl., § 72, 5), [[44-acts.15.2|Act.15:2 18:2]] (διατ-, WH) [[44-acts.22.10|Act.22:10;]] ἑαυτούς, [[46-1-corinthians.16.15|1Co.16:15;]] pass., [[40-matthew.8.9|Mat.8:9]] (T [WH], R, txt., om.), [[42-luke.7.8|Luk.7:8]], [[45-romans.13.1|Rom.13:1]]; ὅσοι ἦσαν τεταγμένοι εἰς ζωὴν αἰώνιον (perh. in mid. sense; see EGT and Page, in l), [[44-acts.13.48|Act.13:48;]] mid., to appoint for oneself or by one's own authority, [[40-matthew.28.16|Mat.28:16]], [[44-acts.28.23|Act.28:23]].
(AS)
5022:
**ταῦρος**, -ου, ὁ 
[in LXX chiefly for שׁוֹר ;] 
**a bull**: [[40-matthew.22.4|Mat.22:4]], [[44-acts.14.13|Act.14:13]], [[58-hebrews.9.13|Heb.9:13 10:4]].
(AS)
5027:
**ταφή**, -ῆς, ἡ 
(θάπτω), [in LXX chiefly for קָבַר and cognate forms ;] 
**burial**: [[40-matthew.27.7|Mat.27:7]] (Hdt., al.; for other meanings, see LS, see word, Deiss., BS, 355 f., MM xxiv).
(AS)
5028:
**τάφος**, -ου, ὁ
(θάντω), [in LXX chiefly for קֶבֶר ;] 
1. a burial (Hom., al.). 
2. **a grave, tomb **(Res., Hdt., al.): [[40-matthew.23.27|Mat.23:27, 29 27:61, 64 27:66 28:1]], [[45-romans.3.13|Rom.3:13]]" (LXX) .
(AS)
5029:
**τάχα** 
(ταχύς), 
_adv._, [in LXX: Wis.13:6 14:19 * ;] 
(a) (chiefly poët.), quickly, presently; 
(b) **perhaps**: [[45-romans.5.7|Rom.5:7]], Phm 15.
(AS)
5030:
**ταχέως**
(ταχύς) 
_adv._, [in LXX chiefly for מְהֵרָה and cognate forms ;] 
**quickly, hastily**: [[42-luke.14.21|Luk.14:21 16:6]], [[43-john.11.31|Jhn.11:31]], [[46-1-corinthians.4.19|1Co.4:19]], [[50-philippians.2.19|Php.2:19, 24]], [[55-2-timothy.4.9|2Ti.4:9]]; with suggestion of rashness, [[48-galatians.1.6|Gal.1:6]], [[53-2-thessalonians.2.2|2Th.2:2]], [[54-1-timothy.5.22|1Ti.5:22]].
(AS)
5031:
**ταχινός**, -ή, -όν 
[in LXX: [[20-proverbs.1.16|Pro.1:16]], [[35-habakkuk.1.6|Hab.1:6]], [[23-isaiah.59.7|Isa.59:7]] (מָהַר), Wis.13:2, Sir.11:22 18:26 * ;] 
poët. and late for ταχύς, **swift**: of swift approach, [[61-2-peter.1.14|2Pe.1:14 2:1]].
(AS)
5032:
**τάχειον**, see: ταχύ.
**ταχύ**
(neut. of ταχύς), 
_adv._, [in LXX chiefly for מָהַר pi. ;] 
**quickly, speedily, forthwith**: [[40-matthew.5.25|Mat.5:25 28:7-8]], [[41-mark.9.39|Mrk.9:39]], [[42-luke.15.22|Luk.15:22]], [[43-john.11.29|Jhn.11:29]], [[66-revelation.2.16|Rev.2:16 3:11 11:14 22:7, 12 22:2]] o. Compar., τάχειον (T, Rec. τάχιον), = cl. θᾶσσον, θᾶττον (Att..), (see Bl., § 44, 3): [[43-john.13.27|Jhn.13:27 20:4]], [[54-1-timothy.3.14|1Ti.3:14]] (T, Rec.), [[58-hebrews.13.19|Heb.13:19, 23]] Superl., τάχιστα: ὡς τ., as quickly as possible (BL, § 11, 3), [[44-acts.17.15|Act.17:15.]]

5034:
**τάχος**, -ους, τό 
[in LXX chiefly for parts and derivatives of מָהַר ;] 
swiftness, speed. Adverbially, ἐν τ. (ταχέως), **quickly, speedily, soon**: [[42-luke.18.8|Luk.18:8]], [[44-acts.12.7|Act.12:7 22:18 25:4]], [[45-romans.16.20|Rom.16:20]], [[54-1-timothy.3.14|1Ti.3:14]], [[66-revelation.1.1|Rev.1:1 22:6]].
(AS)
5035:
**ταχύ**
(neut. of ταχύς), 
_adv._, [in LXX chiefly for מָהַר pi. ;] 
**quickly, speedily, forthwith**: [[40-matthew.5.25|Mat.5:25 28:7-8]], [[41-mark.9.39|Mrk.9:39]], [[42-luke.15.22|Luk.15:22]], [[43-john.11.29|Jhn.11:29]], [[66-revelation.2.16|Rev.2:16 3:11 11:14 22:7, 12 22:2]] o. Compar., τάχειον (T, Rec. τάχιον), = cl. θᾶσσον, θᾶττον (Att..), (see Bl., § 44, 3): [[43-john.13.27|Jhn.13:27 20:4]], [[54-1-timothy.3.14|1Ti.3:14]] (T, Rec.), [[58-hebrews.13.19|Heb.13:19, 23]] Superl., τάχιστα: ὡς τ., as quickly as possible (BL, § 11, 3), [[44-acts.17.15|Act.17:15.]]
(AS)
5036:
**ταχύς**, -εῖα, -ύ 
[in LXX chiefly for מָהַר pi. ;] 
**quick, swift, speedy**: opposite to βραδύς, Ja 119.
(AS)
5037:
**τέ**, 
_enclitic copulative particle_ (= Lat. -que as καί = and, ac, atque, not very frequently in NT, more than two-thirds of the occurrences being in _Ac. _ 
1. τέ solitarium, **and**, denoting a closer affinity than καί between words and sentences which it connects (BL, §77, 8): [[40-matthew.28.12|Mat.28:12]], [[43-john.4.42|Jhn.4:42]], [[44-acts.2.33|Act.2:33, 37 40 10:22 11:21]], al. 
2. Denoting a closer connection than simple καί, τὲ . . . καί, τὲ καί, τὲ . . . τέ ([[44-acts.26.16|Act.26:16]] [[45-romans.14.8|Rom.14:8]]), **as well . . . as also, both . . . and**: [[42-luke.12.45|Luk.12:45]], [[44-acts.1.1|Act.1:1 15:9, 21:30]], al.; τὲ . . . δέ, **and . . . and**, [[44-acts.19.2|Act.19:2;]] τὲ γάρ . . . ὁμοίως δὲ καί, [[45-romans.1.26|Rom.1:26, 27]].
(AS)
5038:
**τεῖχος**, -ους, τό 
[in LXX chiefly for חוֹמָה ;] 
a wall, esp. that about a town: [[44-acts.9.25|Act.9:25]], [[47-2-corinthians.11.33|2Co.11:33]], [[58-hebrews.11.30|Heb.11:30]], [[66-revelation.21.12|Rev.21:12-19]] 
(AS)
5039:
**τεκμήριον**, -ου, τό
(τέκμαρ, a mark, sign), [in LXX: Wis.5:4 19:13, 3Ma.3:24 * ;] 
**a sure sign, a positive proof**: [[44-acts.1.1|Act.1:1-26]] (for exx., see MM, xxiv).
_SYN._: ἔνδειγμα, q.v (AS)
5040:
**τεκνίον**, -ου, τό
(dimin. of τέκνον), 
**a little child**: as a term of endearment, in voc. pl., [[43-john.13.33|Jhn.13:33]], [[48-galatians.4.19|Gal.4:19]], [[62-1-john.2.1|1Jn.2:1]] [[43-john.2.12|Jn 2:12]] [[43-john.2.28|Jn 2:28]] [[43-john.3.7|Jn 3:7]] [[43-john.3.13|Jn 3:13]] [[43-john.4.4|Jn 4:4]] [[43-john.5.21|Jn 5:21]].
(AS)
5044:
**τεκνο-τροφέω**, -ῶ 
to rear young (of bees, Arist.), 
**to bring up children**: [[54-1-timothy.5.10|1Ti.5:10.]]
(AS)
5045:
**τέκτων**, -ονος, ὁ 
[in LXX chiefly for חָרָשׁ ;] 
an artificer in wood, stone or metal, but esp. a carpenter (see MM, xxiv): [[40-matthew.13.55|Mat.13:55]], [[41-mark.6.3|Mrk.6:3]].
(AS)
5046:
**τέλειος**, -α, -ον
(τέλος), [in LXX chiefly for שָׁלֵם, תָּמִים and cogn. forms ;] 
**having reached its end, finished, mature, complete, perfect**; 
1. of persons, primarily of physical development, 
(a) **full-grown, mature**: [[58-hebrews.5.14|Heb.5:14;]] ethically: [[50-philippians.3.15|Php.3:15;]] opposite to νήπιος (-άζειν), [[46-1-corinthians.2.6|1Co.2:6 14:20]], [[49-ephesians.4.13|Eph.4:13]]; τ. καὶ πεπληροφορημένοι, [[51-colossians.4.12|Col.4:12;]] τ. ἐν Χριστῷ, [[51-colossians.1.28|Col.1:28;]] 
(b) complete, perfect (expressing the simple idea of complete goodness, without reference either to maturity or to the philosophical idea of a τέλος; see Hort on [[59-james.1.4|Jas.1:4]]): [[40-matthew.5.48|Mat.5:48 19:21]], [[59-james.1.4|Jas.1:4 3:2]]; of God, [[40-matthew.5.48|Mat.5:48.]] 
2. **Of things, complete, perfect**: [[45-romans.12.2|Rom.12:2;]] ἔργον, [[59-james.1.4|Jas.1:4;]] νόμος, [[59-james.1.25|Jas.1:25;]] δώρημα, [[59-james.1.17|Jas.1:17;]] ἀγάπη, [[62-1-john.4.18|1Jn.4:18;]] τὸ τ., [[46-1-corinthians.13.10|1Co.13:10;]] compar., τελειοτέρα (σκηνή), [[58-hebrews.9.11|Heb.9:11.]] 
(There is probably no reference in St. Paul's usage to the use of this term in the ancient mysteries; cf. _ICC_ on [[51-colossians.1.28|Col.1:28;]] but see also Lft., in l, and _Notes_, 173 f.) 
_SYN._: see: ὁλόκληρος (and cf. Rendall, He., 158 ff.) (AS)
5048:
**τελειόω**, -ῶ
(τέλειος), [in LXX: [[02-exodus.29.9|Exo.29:9]], [[03-leviticus.4.5|Lev.4:5]], al. (τ. χεῖρ מָלֵא pi.), [[10-2-samuel.22.26|2Ki.22:26]], al. (תָּמַם), Wis.4:13, al. (cf. Westc., He., 64) ;] 
1. **bring to an end, finish, accomplish, fulfil**: [[43-john.4.34|Jhn.4:34]], [[44-acts.20.24|Act.20:24]]; of time, [[42-luke.2.43|Luk.2:43]], [[43-john.5.36|Jhn.5:36 17:4]]; pass., ἡ γραφή, [[43-john.19.28|Jhn.19:28.]] 
2. **to bring to maturity or completeness, to complete, perfect**; 
(a) **of things**: [[58-hebrews.7.19|Heb.7:19]], [[59-james.2.22|Jas.2:22]], [[62-1-john.2.5|1Jn.2:5]] [[43-john.4.12|Jn 4:12]] [[43-john.4.17|Jn 4:17]] : 
(b) **of persons, in ethical and spiritual sense**: [[58-hebrews.2.10|Heb.2:10 9:9 10:1, 14]]; pass., [[42-luke.13.32|Luk.13:32]], [[43-john.17.23|Jhn.17:23]], [[50-philippians.3.12|Php.3:12]], [[58-hebrews.5.9|Heb.5:9 7:28 11:40 12:23]], [[62-1-john.4.18|1Jn.4:18]] (for a different view of the meaning in [[58-hebrews.2.10|Heb.2:10]], al., see Rendall, in l).
(AS)
5050:
**τελείωσις**, -εως, ἡ
(τελειόω), [in LXX chiefly for מִלֻּא, [[02-exodus.29.22|Exo.29:22]], al. ;] 
**fulfilment, completion, perfection**: [[42-luke.1.45|Luk.1:45]], [[58-hebrews.7.11|Heb.7:11]].
(AS)
5052:
**τελεσφορέω**, -ῶ
(τέλος, φέρω) [in LXX: 4Ma.13:20 * ;] 
(a) of plants, **to bring fruit to perfection **(Theophr.): [[42-luke.8.14|Luk.8:14]] 
(b) of females, to bear perfect offspring (Artemid.; 4Mac, l.with).
(AS)
5053:
**τελευτάω**, -ῶ
(τελευτή), [in LXX chiefly for מוּת ;] 
1. trans., to complete, finish; esp. τ. τ. αἰῶνα, τ. βίον, to complete life, to die (Æsch., Hdt., al.). 
2. Intrans., **to come to an end, hence, to die **(Hdt., al.): [[40-matthew.2.19|Mat.2:19 9:18 22:25]], [[41-mark.9.48|Mrk.9:48]], [[42-luke.7.2|Luk.7:2]], [[43-john.11.39|Jhn.11:39]], [[44-acts.2.29|Act.2:29 7:15]], [[58-hebrews.11.22|Heb.11:22]]; Hebraistically, θανάτῳ τελευτάτω (מוּת, [[02-exodus.21.17|Exo.21:17]]), [[40-matthew.15.4|Mat.15:4]], [[41-mark.7.10|Mrk.7:10]]" (LXX) .
(AS)
5054:
**τελευτή**, -ῆς, ἡ
(τελέω), [in LXX chiefly for מוּת, מָוֶת ;] 
1. a finishing. 
2. **an end**: τ. βίου (Hdt., al.): also without βίου, the end of life, **death **(Hdt., Plat., al.): [[40-matthew.2.15|Mat.2:15.]]
(AS)
5055:
**τελέω**, -ῶ

5181:
1. **an absolute sovereign **, unlimited by law or constitution, (Herdotus Historicus), etc.: not applied to old hereditary sovereignties βασιλεῖαι); such as those of (Homer) or of Sparta; for the term rather regards the irregular way in which the power was **gained **, than the way in which it was **exercised **, being applied to the mild Pisistratus, but not to the despotic kings of Persia. However, the word soon came to imply reproach, like our **tyrant **, (Plato Philosophus), etc. 
2. in a wider sense, **the tyrant's son **, or **any member of his family **, (Sophocles Tragicus):—;so, ἡ τύραννος was both **the queen ** herself or **a princess **, (Euripides)
